sources.title: Path of Building Community 2.66.2 source snapshot
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Pins the current public release used as the primary AUD-001 format profile.
Provides the release implementation for share-code intake, XML loading and saving, item pools, item sets, slots, jewels, and item-set cross-references.
sources.limitations: This is an implementation snapshot, not a formal or forward-compatible serialization specification. The XML does not embed this application version.
sources.notes: Release page: https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/releases/tag/v2.66.2. Relevant paths were compared with the separately pinned dev snapshot.

sources.title: Path of Building Community current item-set and import implementation
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Defines current share-code Base64 substitutions and the calls to host Deflate and Inflate.
Defines the PathOfBuilding root loader and saver plus current item-pool, item-set, slot, active-set, alternate-weapon, Abyssal-slot, passive-jewel, and minion item-set-reference behavior.
Shows that item and item-set IDs are local numeric keys, item-set order is mutable, item text can contain a Unique ID line, and API reimport currently matches that value when present.
Shows current legacy handling for top-level Item/Slot assignments and current normalization or omission behavior that Golden Glory Lab must not treat as preservation guarantees.
sources.limitations: The source is a moving development snapshot and not a formal schema. Current PoB ignores some unknown structures, can reset invalid references, and rebuilds item text when saving.
sources.notes: Inspected exact paths and symbols: src/Classes/ImportTab.lua (self.controls.generateCode callback, local importCodeHandle callback, ImportItem, ImportSocketedItems, GetOrCreateGuardianItemSet, AssignGuardianItemSet); src/Modules/Build.lua (buildMode:LoadDB, buildMode:SaveDB); src/Classes/ItemsTab.lua (Load, Save, NewItemSet, SetActiveItemSet, AddItem, IsItemValidForSlot); src/Classes/ItemSlotControl.lua (SetSelItemId, Populate); src/Classes/PassiveSpec.lua (Load, Save); src/Classes/TreeTab.lua (Load, Save); src/Classes/SkillsTab.lua (LoadSkill, Save); src/Classes/Item.lua (ParseRaw, BuildRaw, BuildAndParseRaw); src/Classes/ItemSetListControl.lua; runtime/lua/base64.lua; src/GameVersions.lua.

sources.title: Path of Building 1.4.37 item-set introduction
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Introduces ItemSet elements with numeric IDs, titles, per-set alternate-weapon state, and nested Slot references.
Demonstrates a transitional saver that writes both the active legacy top-level Slot representation and nested ItemSet representations.
sources.limitations: This historical implementation does not establish the current format or a permanent compatibility guarantee.
sources.notes: The changelog at the same commit was also inspected: https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/blob/9f981583f7c721917124d604cddf0e8102e62714/changelog.txt. It describes item sets as switchable gear configurations and selectable for minions.

sources.title: Path of Building 1.4.36 pre-item-set serialization
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Shows the legacy Items representation with a document item pool, top-level Slot elements, and Items/useSecondWeaponSet before ItemSet elements existed.
sources.limitations: This historical implementation only supports the bounded legacy profile; it is not evidence for current slot vocabulary or current item parsing.
sources.notes: Commit subject is Release 1.4.36. Exact Load and Save implementations in Classes/ItemsTab.lua were inspected.

sources.title: Path of Building API import and reimport tests
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Provides current regression evidence that API reimport preserves a selected minion item-set reference in its covered case.
Provides synthetic API import/reimport examples relevant to the boundary around item Unique ID matching.
sources.limitations: The tests do not define the complete XML grammar, malformed-input behavior, Golden Glory Lab preservation behavior, or cross-document identifier stability.
sources.notes: Used only to bound direct test coverage; implementation claims are tied to the source snapshot record.

sources.title: Path of Building SimpleGraphic zlib host functions
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Defines the host l_Deflate and l_Inflate functions called by Path of Building's share-code implementation.
Shows that those functions initialize zlib streams and that the current host applies input and output size guards.
sources.limitations: Host limits and implementation details can change; this source does not define Golden Glory Lab's future safety limits.
sources.notes: Relevant symbols are l_Deflate and l_Inflate in ui_api.cpp; the main PoB repository supplies the Base64 and URL-safe substitution steps.

sources.title: Path of Building committed 3.13 build fixtures
sources.gameOrSoftwareVersion: Historical 3.13 fixtures retained at dev commit ef4c5848fad33190f730cebaedff4b5831d0c88d
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Provides committed examples of copied-item text, item-pool references, empty nested item-set slots, legacy top-level slots, passive-tree jewel references, and a minion item-set reference.
sources.limitations: Only five old fixtures are present. Each has one unnamed item set; they do not cover named multiple sets, active alternate weapons, non-empty Abyssal equipment slots, malformed input, or all current fields.
sources.notes: These are incidental implementation fixtures, not a formal schema or Path of Exile mechanics authority.
